question: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020. For these counties, provide the name, state, median age, total population, number of confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people, number of deaths per 100,000 people, and the case fatality rate as a percentage
sql:
SELECT 
    c.county_name AS county_name,
    c.state AS state,
    ct.median_age,
    ct.total_pop,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.confirmed_cases * 100000, ct.total_pop), 2) AS cases_per_100k,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.deaths * 100000, ct.total_pop), 2) AS deaths_per_100k,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.deaths * 100, c.confirmed_cases), 2) AS case_fatality_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.summary` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr` ct
    ON c.county_fips_code = ct.geo_id
WHERE c.date = '2020-08-27'
    AND ct.total_pop > 50000
    AND c.confirmed_cases > 0
ORDER BY case_fatality_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3
